# Pyntflow

> Purpose-built point of sale and inventory management software for paint retailers, authorized dealers, and multi-branch paint enterprise networks.

## Core Capabilities
- High-speed retail counter billing with multi-pack sizing (1L quarter, 4L gallon, 16L drum).
- Computerized paint tint shade lookup and dispenser base tracking.
- Contractor and painter khata ledger management with automated WhatsApp statements.
- Inter-branch inventory transfers, warehouse godown stock tracking, and supplier invoices.
- CEO executive analytics suite with real-time gross margins and branch performance.

- [Pricing Tiers](https://pyntflow.com/#pricing): Flexible subscription plans for single-counter paint shops and enterprise chains.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://pyntflow.com/#faq): Technical details on offline billing, hardware compatibility, and data security.
- [Contact & Support](https://pyntflow.com/#contact): Direct phone and WhatsApp specialist assistance for paint store owners.
